{{Top|leg}}
The '''bluffbeast''' was a type of creature from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[New Bornalex/Legends|New Bornalex]]. It was similar to the ten-[[Limb/Legends|legged]], [[Hair/Legends|furred]] [[mogo]] pack animal of the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]].<ref name="EAOC Roon">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]]</ref>
